definitions.explanation: Used in formal or literary contexts to refer to someone's achievements or legacy
Physical footprints or traces left behind; more formal than あしあと

examples.japanese: ⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な{足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
⟦{先人|せんじん}→先人：23803_senjin⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たどる。
examples.english: To trace the accomplishments of our predecessors.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: This researcher left a great mark on the development of science.

examples.japanese: {雪上|せつじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{足跡|そくせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
⟦{考古学者|こうこがくしゃ}→考古学者：09657_koukogakusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古代人|こだいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発掘現場|はっくつげんば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}した→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
examples.english: The archaeologist discovered ancient human footprints at the excavation site.

notes:
The on'yomi reading そくせき gives this word a formal, literary tone. In sense 1, it is most commonly used figuratively to describe the legacy or achievements someone has left behind. In sense 2, it refers to literal footprints or traces but in a more formal register than the kun'yomi reading あしあと.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a mark/legacy
- {足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たどる: to trace someone's path/achievements
- ⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な{足跡|そくせき}: great achievements
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{足跡|そくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刻|きざ}む→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧: to carve one's mark in history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- あしあと ({足跡|あしあと}): footprint (everyday reading; primarily physical footprints; also used for website visitor logs)
- ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧: achievements, results (focuses on work output rather than lasting legacy)
- ⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧: meritorious service, distinguished achievements (emphasizes the contribution)

PRONUNCIATION:
The same kanji {足跡|あしあと} with the kun'yomi reading is a separate entry (more common in daily life). The そくせき reading is preferred in written Japanese, speeches, and formal contexts.

cross_references.label: Same kanji, kun'yomi reading; used in everyday speech
